tools.name: draw_tarot_cards

tools.name: get_transits

tools.name: get_daily_cosmic_weather

tools.name: calculate_numerology
tools.description: Calculate Pythagorean numerology numbers (life path, expression, soul urge, karmic debt) from a full birth name and date of birth.

tools.name: plan_my_personal_year
tools.description: Calculate the numerology personal year for a calendar year and the personal month theme for each of its 12 months, from a date of birth.

tools.name: build_habit_stack
tools.description: Build a structured 30-day habit plan from a proven habit framework that fits the daily time budget (habits longer than the remaining minutes are left out and listed), phased in week by week with check-in days. Optionally aligns each week with the numerology personal month if a birth date is given.

tools.name: check_my_chakras

tools.name: find_my_crystals

tools.name: search_yinyang_guides
